question: Should Factory Auto mode prefer an available API key over an existing browser/WorkOS session, potentially changing which account is displayed after upgrade?
rationale: Both orders are technically viable and tested, but the default determines user-visible account routing and cannot be settled by implementation correctness alone.

options.title: Accept API-first Auto
options.body: Keep API-first Auto with recoverable web fallback and explicit `api` or `web` selection for account pinning.

options.title: Preserve web-first Auto
options.body: Keep the existing browser/WorkOS account as the Auto default and require explicit API mode for API-key usage.

recommendation.title: Accept API-first Auto
recommendation.body: Keep API-first Auto with recoverable web fallback and explicit `api` or `web` selection for account pinning.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns most recent Factory authentication and source-selection history and is the strongest available decision owner for its default routing policy.
